name: Science Olympiad at Illinois
mission: Join Science Olympiad at Illinois to help run regional and state competitions, write and proctor exams, and mentor local teams while building real-world STEM skills, developing volunteer skills, and connecting with a national network of alumni and Illinois educators.

activities.title: Run Competitions
activities.description: Help run regional and state competitions. Be part of the team that makes a great competition day possible.
activities.detail: Support tournament organizers with event preparation, logistics, and on-the-day volunteering. Specific assignments and opportunities will be shared once confirmed.

activities.title: Write & Proctor Exams
activities.description: Turn your curiosity into thoughtful questions. Help write exams and support a fair testing experience.
activities.detail: Practice clear scientific communication through question development, review, and proctoring. Follow organizer guidance and keep unpublished competition materials confidential.

activities.title: Mentor Local Teams
activities.description: Help students explore STEM, work through challenges, and build confidence in their own ideas.
activities.detail: Support local teams and outreach with explanations, practice, and encouragement. Mentoring arrangements must be coordinated with coaches and approved by the club.

activities.title: Alumni & Educator Network
activities.description: Connect with people who share your love of science, from fellow alumni to Illinois educators.
activities.detail: Exchange perspectives with alumni, teachers, and coaches. Share your experience and discover new ways to support the next generation of Science Olympiad participants.
